rows.label: bf02230100_0010
rows.name:
Special Commissioner Meleph. What brings you
here so suddenly?

rows.label: bf02230100_0020
rows.name:
Had you informed us in advance,
we would have arranged a welcome for you.

rows.label: bf02230100_0030
rows.name:
I'm afraid I have little taste for
such ceremonies. I always decline.

rows.label: bf02230100_0040
rows.name: Please, don't say such things.

rows.label: bf02230100_0050
rows.name:
Someone of your standing, Meleph-sama,
must be received with every courtesy.

rows.label: bf02230100_0060
rows.name:
I would not be able to
face Emperor Nefer.

rows.label: bf02230100_0070
rows.name:
How about it? I'll have dinner
prepared right away.

rows.label: bf02230100_0080
rows.name: Meleph-sama, until then...

rows.label: bf02230100_0090
rows.name:
You made impressive time. I wasn't
expecting you until tomorrow.

rows.label: bf02230100_0100
rows.name: K-Kagutsuchi-sama!

rows.label: bf02230100_0110
rows.name:
If Heaven's Holy Grail has been found,
of course I'd have them hurry.

rows.label: bf02230100_0120
rows.name:
As a result, our ship's engine is headed
straight for the repair shop.

rows.label: bf02230100_0130
rows.name: Heaven's Holy Grail? H-how do you know that?

rows.label: bf02230100_0140
rows.name: Is there a problem, Morph-kun?

rows.label: bf02230100_0150
rows.name: N-no, certainly not...

rows.label: bf02230100_0160
rows.name:
Good. Now, you've captured
a Driver from Iira.

rows.label: bf02230100_0170
rows.name: Where should I go to meet her?

rows.label: bf02230100_0180
rows.name: Wha-? And what would you do after meeting her-

rows.label: bf02230100_0190
rows.name:
Morph-kun. Where should
I go to meet her?

rows.label: bf02230100_0200
rows.name: Y-yes! I'll take you to her right away!
